property_summary: Calling transferOwnership either reverts and leaves owner unchanged, or succeeds and sets owner to the provided newOwner.
Calling owned() succeeds (does not revert) exactly when InvMutTest is the current owner; it reverts for any other caller, and does not change owner.

If transferOwnership succeeds then subsequent owner() equals the newOwner and owned() will not revert; if it reverts then owner() remains the same and owned() reverts exactly when the unchanged owner is not this contract.
